### TRV gene usage in circ and vmix libraries
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
tcr_merged_circ <- read_tsv("source_fig_S3E_circ.txt")
tcr_merged_vmix <- read_tsv("source_fig_S3E_vmix.txt")

# for TRA gene
TRA_circ <- str_split_i(tcr_merged_circ$chainA, "\\+", 1)
TRA_circ <- TRA_circ[TRA_circ != "NA"]
TRA_circ <- as.data.frame(table(TRA_circ))
colnames(TRA_circ) <- c("gene", "count_circ")
TRA_circ$method <- "circ"
TRA_circ$prop_circ <- TRA_circ$count_circ/sum(TRA_circ$count_circ)

TRA_vmix <- str_split_i(tcr_merged_vmix$chainA, "\\+", 1)
TRA_vmix <- TRA_vmix[TRA_vmix != "NA"]
TRA_vmix <- as.data.frame(table(TRA_vmix))
colnames(TRA_vmix) <- c("gene", "count_vmix")
TRA_vmix$method <- "vmix"
TRA_vmix$prop_vmix <- TRA_vmix$count_vmix/sum(TRA_vmix$count_vmix)

TRA_data <- dplyr::full_join(TRA_circ, TRA_vmix, by = "gene")
TRA_data[is.na(TRA_data)] <- 0
# fit <- summary(lm(count_circ~count_vmix, data = TRA_data))
# sqrt(fit$r.squared)
cor(TRA_data$count_circ, TRA_data$count_vmix, method = 'spearman')


ratio <- (max(TRA_data$prop_vmix)-min(TRA_data$prop_vmix))/(max(TRA_data$prop_circ)-min(TRA_data$prop_circ))
ggplot(TRA_data, aes(x = prop_vmix, y = prop_circ)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1 , intercept = 0, size = 1, linetype ="dashed", alpha = 0.7, color = "red") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = gene), show.legend = FALSE, size = 5, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = choose_colorset("bubble", n = nrow(TRA_data))) +
  xlab("Proportion in Vmix") +
  ylab("Proportion in Circ") +
  ggtitle("TRA gene usage") +
  coord_fixed(ratio) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(aes(label = gene),  max.overlaps = 1, box.padding = 0.5)



# for TRB gene
TRB_circ <- str_split_i(tcr_merged_circ$chainB, "\\+", 1)
TRB_circ <- TRB_circ[TRB_circ != "NA"]
TRB_circ <- as.data.frame(table(TRB_circ))
colnames(TRB_circ) <- c("gene", "count_circ")
TRB_circ$method <- "circ"
TRB_circ$prop_circ <- TRB_circ$count_circ/sum(TRB_circ$count_circ)

TRB_vmix <- str_split_i(tcr_merged_vmix$chainB, "\\+", 1)
TRB_vmix <- TRB_vmix[TRB_vmix != "NA"]
TRB_vmix <- as.data.frame(table(TRB_vmix))
colnames(TRB_vmix) <- c("gene", "count_vmix")
TRB_vmix$method <- "vmix"
TRB_vmix$prop_vmix <- TRB_vmix$count_vmix/sum(TRB_vmix$count_vmix)

TRB_data <- dplyr::full_join(TRB_circ, TRB_vmix, by = "gene")
TRB_data[is.na(TRB_data)] <- 0
# fit <- summary(lm(count_circ~count_vmix, data = TRB_data))
# sqrt(fit$r.squared)
cor(TRB_data$count_circ, TRB_data$count_vmix, method = 'spearman')

ratio <- (max(TRB_data$prop_vmix)-min(TRB_data$prop_vmix))/(max(TRB_data$prop_circ)-min(TRB_data$prop_circ))
ggplot(TRB_data, aes(x = prop_vmix, y = prop_circ)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1 , intercept = 0, size = 1, linetype ="dashed", alpha = 0.7, color = "red") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = gene), show.legend = FALSE, size = 5, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = choose_colorset("bubble", n = nrow(TRB_data))) +
  xlab("Proportion in Vmix") +
  ylab("Proportion in Circ") +
  ggtitle("TRB gene usage") +
  coord_fixed(ratio) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(aes(label = gene),  max.overlaps = 1, box.padding = 0.5)

```

          
### TRV gene usage in TAI and 10X
```{r include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=16}

ref_TAI <- read_tsv("TCR_processed_TAI_masked.tsv") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(TRAV = str_extract(chainA, "(.*)\\+(.*)\\+(.*)", group = 1),
                TRBV = str_extract(chainB, "(.*)\\+(.*)\\+(.*)", group = 1)) 
ref_TAI_a <- ref_TAI %>% dplyr::select(sample, TRAV) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TRAV)) %>% 
  group_by(sample, TRAV) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  group_by(sample) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(prop_TAI = 100*n/sum(n))
ref_TAI_b <- ref_TAI %>% dplyr::select(sample, TRBV) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TRBV)) %>% 
  group_by(sample, TRBV) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n = n())%>% 
  group_by(sample) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(prop_TAI = 100*n/sum(n))

ref_10X <- read_tsv("TCR_processed_10X_masked.tsv") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(TRAV = str_extract(chainA, "(.*)\\+(.*)\\+(.*)", group = 1),
                TRBV = str_extract(chainB, "(.*)\\+(.*)\\+(.*)", group = 1)) 
ref_10X_a <- ref_10X %>% dplyr::select(sample, TRAV) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TRAV)) %>% 
  group_by(sample, TRAV) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  group_by(sample) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(prop_10X = 100*n/sum(n))
ref_10X_b <- ref_10X %>% dplyr::select(sample, TRBV) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(TRBV)) %>% 
  group_by(sample, TRBV) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n = n())%>% 
  group_by(sample) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(prop_10X = 100*n/sum(n))

data_a <- inner_join(ref_10X_a, ref_TAI_a, by = c("TRAV", "sample"))
data_b <- inner_join(ref_10X_b, ref_TAI_b, by = c("TRBV", "sample"))

plist <- list()
for(pat in c("D2", "D1", "D4", "D3")){
  ppdata <- data_a %>% dplyr::filter(sample == pat) 
  sp <- cor(ppdata$prop_10X, ppdata$prop_TAI, method = "spearman")
  p <- ggplot(ppdata, aes(x = prop_10X, y = prop_TAI)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = TRAV), show.legend = FALSE, size = 5, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              size = 1, linetype ="dashed", alpha = 0.5, color = "blue") +
    theme_classic() +
    ylab("TAI") +
    xlab("10X") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 10, color = c("black", "black")),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
    # coord_equal(ratio) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = choose_colorset("bubble", nrow(ppdata))) +
    ggtitle(paste0(pat, "_", sp, "_TRA")) +
    xlim(0, 10) +
    ylim(0, 10)
  plist <- c(plist, list(p))
  
  ppdata <- data_b %>% dplyr::filter(sample == pat)
  sp <- cor(ppdata$prop_10X, ppdata$prop_TAI, method = "spearman")
  p <- ggplot(ppdata, aes(x = prop_10X, y = prop_TAI)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = TRBV), show.legend = FALSE, size = 5, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                size = 1, linetype ="dashed", alpha = 0.5, color = "blue") +
    theme_classic() +
    ylab("TAI") +
    xlab("10X") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 10, color = c("black", "black")),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
    # coord_equal(ratio) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = choose_colorset("bubble", nrow(ppdata))) +
    ggtitle(paste0(pat, "_", sp, "_TRB"))  +
    xlim(0, 10) +
    ylim(0, 10)
  plist <- c(plist, list(p))
}
wrap_plots(plist, nrow = 2)

```


### Heatmaps of GEX
```{r eval=FALSE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=5}

proj$minor_celltype <- as.character(proj$minor_celltype)
cord <- c("HSC_CD34", "Mono_CD14", "Mono_FCGR3A", "DC_CCL22", "B_TNFRSF13B", 
  "B_IGHM", "B_CCL22", "CD8T_CCR7", "CD8T_FOSB", "CD8T_ITGA1", 
  "CD8T_KLRG1", "CD8T_GZMB", "MAIT_SLC4A10", "CD4T_CCR7", "CD4T_CCR4", 
  "CD4T_FOXP3", "GDT_TRDC", "NK_NCAM1")

# gene expression
markersGenes <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchRProj = proj, 
                                  useMatrix = "GeneExpressionMatrix", 
                                  groupBy = "minor_celltype", 
                                  bias = c("Gex_nUMI"), 
                                  testMethod = "wilcoxon")
markerList <- getMarkers(markersGenes, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.05 & Log2FC >= 0.5")
markerList2 <- lapply(markerList, function(x) {
  df <- tibble(as.data.frame(x))
  df %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Log2FC)) %>% slice_head(n = 8) %>% dplyr::select(name)
})
genes <- unique(unlist(markerList2))
hm <- plotMarkerHeatmap(seMarker = markersGenes, cutOff = "FDR <= 1 & Log2FC >= 0.0", transpose = FALSE, returnMatrix = TRUE, clusterCols = FALSE, binaryClusterRows = TRUE)
hm <- binarysort_heatmap(hm[genes,cord], cutOff = 1.0, clusterCols = FALSE, scale = FALSE, invert = FALSE)$mat
pheatmap::pheatmap(hm[,cord],
                   show_colnames = TRUE,
                   show_rownames = TRUE,
                   cluster_rows = FALSE,
                   cluster_cols = FALSE,
                   border_color = NA,
                   treeheight_col = 0,
                   treeheight_row = 6,
                   clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                   scale = "none",
                   color = choose_colorset("gothic"),
                   fontsize_row = 4,
                   angle_col = 45,
                   width = 2.5, height = 4)


  
```

### Heatmaps of TFs
```{r eval=FALSE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=8, fig.width=5}

proj$minor_celltype <- as.character(proj$minor_celltype)
cord <- c("HSC_CD34", "Mono_CD14", "Mono_FCGR3A", "DC_CCL22", "B_TNFRSF13B", 
  "B_IGHM", "B_CCL22", "CD8T_CCR7", "CD8T_FOSB", "CD8T_ITGA1", 
  "CD8T_KLRG1", "CD8T_GZMB", "MAIT_SLC4A10", "CD4T_CCR7", "CD4T_CCR4", 
  "CD4T_FOXP3", "GDT_TRDC", "NK_NCAM1")

# motifs
markersMotif <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchRProj = proj, useMatrix = "MotifMatrix", groupBy = "minor_celltype", 
                                  bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), testMethod = "wilcoxon", useSeqnames = "z")
markerList <- getMarkers(markersMotif, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.05 & MeanDiff > 0.3")
markerList2 <- lapply(markerList, function(x) {
  df <- tibble(as.data.frame(x))
  df %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(MeanDiff)) %>% slice_head(n = 8) %>% dplyr::select(idx)
})
idx <- unique(unlist(markerList2))
hm <- assay(markersMotif)[idx,]
rownames(hm) <- rowData(markersMotif)$name[idx]
hm <- as.matrix(hm[,])
hm <- sweep(hm - rowMeans(hm), 1, matrixStats::rowSds(hm), `/`)
hm <- binarysort_heatmap(hm[,cord], scale = TRUE, clusterCols = FALSE, invert = FALSE, cutOff = 1)$mat
pheatmap::pheatmap(hm[,cord],
                   show_colnames = TRUE,
                   show_rownames = TRUE,
                   cluster_rows = FALSE,
                   cluster_cols = FALSE,
                   border_color = NA,
                   treeheight_col = 0,
                   treeheight_row = 6,
                   clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                   scale = "none",
                   color = choose_colorset("solar_extra"),
                   fontsize_row = 6,
                   width = 2.4, height = 4) 

  
```
